# Rahul Sharma AGL | AGL Knowledge Hub

> Rahul Sharma AGL (rahulsharmaagl.in) is an Airfield Ground Lighting (AGL) engineering knowledge platform covering AGL fundamentals, visual references, components, airport lighting systems, electrical infrastructure, photometry, testing, inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, standards, Indian AGL applications and professional training.

The website combines the AGL Knowledge Hub, AGL Engineering Centre, India-focused AGL references, technical articles and Precision AGL Academy. The pages are educational and technical reference material. For design, tendering, installation, testing, commissioning or regulatory decisions, verify the current applicable ICAO, FAA, DGCA, BIS/IS and IEC publications, airport-approved specifications, drawings and procedures from the relevant issuing authority.

Use the canonical page links below. The extended page catalogue and topic outlines are available in [llms-full.txt](https://rahulsharmaagl.in/llms-full.txt). The published sitemap is [sitemap.xml](https://rahulsharmaagl.in/sitemap.xml).
